message:
My default pick is the Galaxy A56 for value; you don’t need a flagship for everyday use.
• Karizma: Galaxy A56, 256GB/8GB RAM — $400.00, listed in stock with BMS Official Warranty. New condition is not explicitly confirmed.
• Mobileleb: Galaxy S25 FE, 256GB/8GB RAM — $655.00, in stock and explicitly Brand New; a stronger premium Android option.
• Mobileleb: iPhone 16, 128GB — $840.00, in stock and explicitly Brand New; my pick if you prefer iOS.
For Beirut delivery, Mobileleb’s fee is unconfirmed. Karizma advertises free shipping on your first order, but Beirut eligibility and other delivery charges are unconfirmed.
I’d start with the A56 unless gaming or camera performance is a priority. What’s your budget, and do you prefer Android or iPhone?
